symbol_policy.identity: anchor_id as display registry key; not ontology instance ID
symbol_policy.historical_aliases: four through v9.4 symbols.json, not new primaries
symbol_policy.fallback: visible text label; preserve original Unicode if supported

forms.instruction: Domain lens; Unicode glyph centered inside a circular outline/ring. Not a truth or authority mark.
Comparable endpoints; the glyph already differentiates opening and complement.
Resource/object carrier; semantic type is only the Unicode anchor+label, never this box.
State is labelled; status color requires a qualified witness.
Boundary drawn as a frame around an existing element, not permission.
Use the registered Unicode relation arrow inline; neutral line/label optional; no forced shape or accent color.
Region grouping; no hierarchy or access tier inferred.
Module labelled as an outlined container; not evidence of an active runtime.
Actor/principal/role visually grouped while identities remain distinct.
Neutral planning card/node; no implication that work was executed.
UI panel/rail/tab surface; not a semantic home.
Render Unicode directly with accessible text; no shape required.

color_rules.domain_accent: Optional for five X dimensions and their ten endpoints; not proof of state or admission.
color_rules.neutral: All other entities default neutral. A status accent requires externally qualified state evidence.
color_rules.relation_arrows: No forced color; neutral monochrome optional for connecting line, not the mathematical/registered arrow glyph.
color_rules.status: Status colors are only an optional display of a supplied, explicit, scoped state fact; never infer from concept label or glyph alone.

semantics_boundary: Presentation only. Not part of resolver or semantic validator, no SVG dependency.

constraints.test: Every anchor_id MUST map exactly to the 129 v9.4 symbolic records, Unicode codepoint unchanged.
No glyph, geometry or CSS token is a machine Semantic ID or authenticated referent key.
No relation-arrow glyph acquires imposed chromatic role or a wrapper; formal operators have no mandatory color or shape.
Domain color may identify visual perspective only, never Authority, Admission, truth or success.
Status accent requires explicit qualified state source/witness; no green success inferred from glyph, label, parse or binding.
An opening/complement pair remains visually comparable; Result is not Outcome, Completion, Verification or Satisfaction.
All colors and geometric forms have independent visible text/Unicode labels; monochrome rendering preserves distinctions.
No SVG, external font, image or glyph generated from Unicode decomposition is required.
T/F/M/O are qualifiers; color and form cannot create fourth/fifth primary ontology homes.
When a glyph is not available in the user font, fall back to textual label/anchor_id; do not replace the registered Unicode character.
Always preserve v9.4 symbol aesthetic review notes; original v0.9.3 source is historical and used only as design guidance.

lineage.canonical_symbol_registry: AIAEAO Morphology v9.4 Annex J, published P0 /v9.4/visual/symbols.json
lineage.note: Form recommendations are an optional CSS/HTML projection from historical design; not an adopted v9.4 ontology or mandatory renderer.
